Log in

Set up two-step login

One-time setup. From now on, logging in needs your password and a code from your phone, so a leaked password alone can’t get in.

  1. Open an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy, 1Password and others all work).
  2. Add an account and scan this code:
    Can’t scan? Choose “enter a setup key” and type:
  3. Type the 6-digit code the app shows:

This screen expires in 10 minutes. Lost your phone later? Change DASHBOARD_PASSWORD in Cloudflare. That resets two-step login so you can set it up again.

Connection

Ko-fi

Checking

How to connect Ko-fi
  1. On your Ko-fi (ko-fi.com/dismeigh), go to Settings → More → API.
  2. Paste this as the Webhook URL:
  3. Copy the Verification Token from that page into the Cloudflare secret KOFI_VERIFICATION_TOKEN, then redeploy.
  4. Use Ko-fi’s “Send Test” button. “Last payment received” should update.

The site only keeps each payment’s amount, type and time. Names, emails and messages are never stored.

Housekeeping

Link check

Tests every outside link on the site and in your content (lore, pinned clip, event, banners). Some sites, like Instagram or TikTok, block checkers, so those show as “couldn’t check”.

For OBS

Stream overlays

In OBS: Sources → + → Browser, paste a link, and set the size. They’re see-through and update on their own.

    Business card

    QR code

    Scanning it opens your site. Made right here in your browser, nothing is sent to an outside QR service.

    Scans

    The card is business-card size (3.5 × 2 in) at print quality. The SVG stays sharp at any size, for stickers or banners.

    Just in case

    Backup and restore

    One file with everything you’ve typed in here: content, site settings, Ko-fi goals, arcade targets, notes, client jobs and Ship’s Log entries. No passwords, login codes or visitor info.

      Security

      Login history

      Logins and failed tries from the last 90 days. If you see one that wasn’t you, change DASHBOARD_PASSWORD in Cloudflare right away. That signs everyone out and resets two-step login.

      On your phone

      Install the dashboard

      Add the dashboard to your home screen to use it like an app. On iPhone: Share → Add to Home Screen. On Android: the menu → Install app.
